# Eire Reborn - Irish activities. Generated by tools/gen_activities.py

### Óenach
activity_eir_oenach = {
	is_shown = {
		eir_act_gael_host_trigger = yes
	}

	can_start_showing_failures_only = {
		NOT = { is_activity_type_on_cooldown = activity_eir_oenach }
		is_available_adult = yes
		highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
	}

	is_valid = {
		scope:host = {
			is_playable_character = yes
			is_physically_able_adult = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { is_current_phase_active = yes }
			has_attending_activity_guests = yes
		}
	}

	on_invalidated = {
		invalidation_imprisoned_effect = yes
		invalidation_incapable_effect = yes
		invalidation_unlanded_effect = yes
		invalidation_nobody_present_effect = yes
		invalidation_host_isolated_effect = yes
	}

	on_host_death = {
		invalidation_host_death_effect = yes
	}

	wait_time_before_start = { months = 2 }

	max_guest_arrival_delay_time = { months = 3 }

	is_single_location = yes

	province_filter = domain
	ai_province_filter = capital

	is_location_valid = {
		has_holding = yes
	}

	max_province_icons = 5

	cost = {
		gold = {
			add = {
				value = eir_act_cost_modest
				desc = eir_act_cost_modest
			}
		}
	}

	ui_predicted_cost = {
		gold = {
			value = eir_act_cost_fair
			divide = 5
			ceiling = yes
			multiply = 5
		}
	}

	cooldown = { years = 5 }

	options = {
		eir_oenach_scale = {
			eir_oenach_scale_modest = {
				default = yes
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
			eir_oenach_scale_fair = {
				cost = {
					gold = {
						add = {
							value = eir_act_cost_fair
							desc = eir_oenach_scale_fair
						}
					}
				}
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
			eir_oenach_scale_grand = {
				cost = {
					gold = {
						add = {
							value = eir_act_cost_grand
							desc = eir_oenach_scale_grand
						}
					}
				}
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
		}
		eir_oenach_focus = {
			eir_oenach_focus_law = {
				default = yes
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
			eir_oenach_focus_games = {
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
			eir_oenach_focus_market = {
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
		}
	}

	phases = {
		eir_oenach_phase = {
			is_predefined = yes

			on_phase_active = {
				if = {
					limit = { this = scope:host }
					scope:activity = { progress_activity_phase_after = { weeks = 3 } }
					trigger_event = { id = eir.1101 days = 2 }
				}
			}

			on_end = {
				eir_act_intent_reward_effect = yes
				if = {
					limit = { this = scope:host }
					trigger_event = { id = eir.1102 days = 3 }
					scope:activity = {
						add_activity_log_entry = {
							key = eir_oenach_conc
							score = 100
							show_in_conclusion = yes
							character = root
							if = {
								limit = {
									scope:activity = {
										has_activity_option = {
											category = eir_oenach_scale
											option = eir_oenach_scale_modest
										}
									}
								}
								root = {
									add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
								}
							}
							else_if = {
								limit = {
									scope:activity = {
										has_activity_option = {
											category = eir_oenach_scale
											option = eir_oenach_scale_fair
										}
									}
								}
								root = {
									add_prestige = major_prestige_gain
								}
							}
							else_if = {
								limit = {
									scope:activity = {
										has_activity_option = {
											category = eir_oenach_scale
											option = eir_oenach_scale_grand
										}
									}
								}
								root = {
									add_prestige = major_prestige_gain
									add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
								}
							}
							every_attending_character = {
								limit = { this != root }
								custom = every_guest_scope_tt
								add_opinion = {
									target = root
									modifier = eir_act_hosted_opinion
									opinion = 10
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	pulse_actions = {
		entries = { eir_oenach_lawsuit eir_oenach_race eir_oenach_poem eir_oenach_match eir_oenach_cattle eir_oenach_brawl eir_oenach_insult eir_oenach_thief eir_oenach_fires }
		chance_of_no_event = 15
	}

	max_guests = 40

	guest_invite_rules = {
		defaults = {
			1 = activity_invite_rule_friends
			2 = activity_invite_rule_vassals
			3 = activity_invite_rule_courtiers
		}
		rules = {
			2 = activity_invite_rule_close_family
			3 = activity_invite_rule_fellow_vassals
			4 = activity_invite_rule_rivals_if_appropriate
		}
	}

	can_be_activity_guest = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_available = yes
		in_diplomatic_range = scope:host
	}

	host_intents = {
		intents = { eir_judgement_intent eir_renown_intent eir_match_intent reduce_stress_intent }
		default = reduce_stress_intent
	}

	guest_intents = {
		intents = { eir_judgement_intent eir_renown_intent eir_match_intent reduce_stress_intent }
		default = reduce_stress_intent
	}

	guest_join_chance = {
		base = 20
		base_activity_modifier = yes
		activity_guest_shared_ai_accept_modifier = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
	}

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 0
		empire = 0
		hegemony = 0
	}

	ai_will_select_province = {
		value = 10
	}

	map_entity = "building_western_feast_01_entity"

	header_background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/activity_header_backgrounds/activity_festival.dds"

	background = {
		trigger = {
			scope:host.location != scope:activity.activity_location
		}
		texture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/ep2_travel_hills.dds"
		environment = "environment_travel_hills_settlement"
		ambience = "event:/SFX/Events/Backgrounds/fields_farms_day"
	}
	background = {
		texture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/bp1_plains.dds"
		environment = "environment_event_bp1_plains"
		ambience = "event:/SFX/Events/Backgrounds/fields_farms_day"
	}

	window_characters = {
		host = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location = scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					scope:host = {
						add_to_list = characters
					}
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = personality_bold
			}
		}
		travel_host = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location != scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					scope:host = {
						add_to_list = characters
					}
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = jockey_walk
			}
		}
		guest = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				every_attending_character = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location = scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					add_to_list = characters
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = happiness
			}
		}
	}
}

### Feis of Tara
activity_eir_feis = {
	is_shown = {
		eir_act_feis_host_trigger = yes
	}

	can_start_showing_failures_only = {
		NOT = { is_activity_type_on_cooldown = activity_eir_feis }

		eir_irish_king_trigger = yes
	}

			is_playable_character = yes

	host_intents = {
		intents = { eir_fealty_intent eir_genealogy_intent eir_peace_intent reduce_stress_intent }
		default = reduce_stress_intent
	}

	guest_intents = {
		intents = { eir_fealty_intent eir_genealogy_intent eir_peace_intent reduce_stress_intent }
		default = reduce_stress_intent
	}

	guest_join_chance = {
		base = 20
		base_activity_modifier = yes
		activity_guest_shared_ai_accept_modifier = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
	}

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 0
		empire = 0
		hegemony = 0
	}

	ai_will_select_province = {
		value = 10
	}

	map_entity = "building_western_feast_01_entity"

	header_background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/activity_header_backgrounds/activity_feast.dds"

	background = {
		trigger = {
			scope:host.location != scope:activity.activity_location
		}
		texture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/ep2_travel_hills.dds"
		environment = "environment_travel_hills_settlement"
		ambience = "event:/SFX/Events/Backgrounds/fields_farms_day"
	}
	background = {
		texture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/feast.dds"
		environment = "environment_event_feast"
		ambience = "event:/SFX/Events/Backgrounds/feasthall"
	}

	window_characters = {
		host = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location = scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					scope:host = {
						add_to_list = characters
					}
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = personality_bold
			}
		}
		travel_host = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location != scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					scope:host = {
						add_to_list = characters
					}
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = jockey_walk
			}
		}
		guest = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				every_attending_character = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location = scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					add_to_list = characters
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = happiness
			}
		}
	}
}

### Irish Pilgrimage
activity_eir_pilgrimage = {
	is_shown = {
		eir_act_pilgrim_host_trigger = yes
	}

	can_start_showing_failures_only = {
		NOT = { is_activity_type_on_cooldown = activity_eir_pilgrimage }
		is_available_adult = yes
		piety >= 0
	}

	is_valid = {
		scope:host = {
			is_playable_character = yes
			is_physically_able_adult = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { is_current_phase_active = yes }
			has_attending_activity_guests = yes
		}
	}

	on_invalidated = {
		invalidation_imprisoned_effect = yes
		invalidation_incapable_effect = yes
		invalidation_unlanded_effect = yes
		invalidation_nobody_present_effect = yes
		invalidation_host_isolated_effect = yes
	}

	on_host_death = {
		invalidation_host_death_effect = yes
	}

	wait_time_before_start = { months = 1 }

	max_guest_arrival_delay_time = { months = 3 }

	is_single_location = yes

	province_filter = domain
	ai_province_filter = capital

	is_location_valid = {
		has_holding = yes
	}

	max_province_icons = 5

	cost = {
		gold = {
			add = {
				value = eir_act_cost_modest
				desc = eir_act_cost_modest
			}
		}
	}

	ui_predicted_cost = {
		gold = {
			value = eir_act_cost_fair
			divide = 5
			ceiling = yes
			multiply = 5
		}
	}

	cooldown = { years = 4 }

	options = {
		eir_pilgrimage_scale = {
			eir_pilgrimage_scale_modest = {
				default = yes
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
			eir_pilgrimage_scale_fair = {
				cost = {
					gold = {
						add = {
							value = eir_act_cost_fair
							desc = eir_pilgrimage_scale_fair
						}
					}
				}
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
			eir_pilgrimage_scale_grand = {
				cost = {
					gold = {
						add = {
							value = eir_act_cost_grand
							desc = eir_pilgrimage_scale_grand
						}
					}
				}
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
		}
		eir_pilgrimage_focus = {
			eir_pilgrimage_focus_croagh = {
				default = yes
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
			eir_pilgrimage_focus_skellig = {
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
			eir_pilgrimage_focus_derg = {
				ai_will_do = {
					value = 10
				}
			}
		}
	}

	phases = {
		eir_pilgrimage_phase = {
			is_predefined = yes

			on_phase_active = {
				if = {
					limit = { this = scope:host }
					scope:activity = { progress_activity_phase_after = { weeks = 3 } }
					trigger_event = { id = eir.1107 days = 2 }
				}
			}

			on_end = {
				eir_act_intent_reward_effect = yes
				if = {
					limit = { this = scope:host }
					trigger_event = { id = eir.1108 days = 3 }
					scope:activity = {
						add_activity_log_entry = {
							key = eir_pilgrimage_conc
							score = 100
							show_in_conclusion = yes
							character = root
							if = {
								limit = {
									scope:activity = {
										has_activity_option = {
											category = eir_pilgrimage_scale
											option = eir_pilgrimage_scale_modest
										}
									}
								}
								root = {
									add_piety = medium_piety_gain
								}
							}
							else_if = {
								limit = {
									scope:activity = {
										has_activity_option = {
											category = eir_pilgrimage_scale
											option = eir_pilgrimage_scale_fair
										}
									}
								}
								root = {
									add_piety = major_piety_gain
								}
							}
							else_if = {
								limit = {
									scope:activity = {
										has_activity_option = {
											category = eir_pilgrimage_scale
											option = eir_pilgrimage_scale_grand
										}
									}
								}
								root = {
									add_piety = major_piety_gain
									add_piety = medium_piety_gain
								}
							}
							every_attending_character = {
								limit = { this != root }
								custom = every_guest_scope_tt
								add_opinion = {
									target = root
									modifier = eir_act_hosted_opinion
									opinion = 10
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	pulse_actions = {
		entries = { eir_pilgrim_fast eir_pilgrim_vision eir_pilgrim_stair eir_pilgrim_hermit eir_pilgrim_alms eir_pilgrim_storm eir_pilgrim_fall eir_pilgrim_doubt eir_pilgrim_song }
		chance_of_no_event = 15
	}

	max_guests = 12

	guest_invite_rules = {
		defaults = {
			1 = activity_invite_rule_friends
			2 = activity_invite_rule_vassals
			3 = activity_invite_rule_courtiers
		}
		rules = {
			2 = activity_invite_rule_close_family
			3 = activity_invite_rule_fellow_vassals
			4 = activity_invite_rule_rivals_if_appropriate
		}
	}

	can_be_activity_guest = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_available = yes
		in_diplomatic_range = scope:host
	}

	host_intents = {
		intents = { eir_penance_intent eir_vision_intent eir_alms_intent reduce_stress_intent }
		default = reduce_stress_intent
	}

	guest_intents = {
		intents = { eir_penance_intent eir_vision_intent eir_alms_intent reduce_stress_intent }
		default = reduce_stress_intent
	}

	guest_join_chance = {
		base = 20
		base_activity_modifier = yes
		activity_guest_shared_ai_accept_modifier = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
	}

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 0
		empire = 0
		hegemony = 0
	}

	ai_will_select_province = {
		value = 10
	}

	map_entity = "building_western_feast_01_entity"

	header_background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/activity_header_backgrounds/activity_pilgrimage.dds"

	background = {
		trigger = {
			scope:host.location != scope:activity.activity_location
		}
		texture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/ep2_travel_hills.dds"
		environment = "environment_travel_hills_settlement"
		ambience = "event:/SFX/Events/Backgrounds/fields_farms_day"
	}
	background = {
		texture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/ep2_holysite_western.dds"
		environment = "environment_western_holy_site"
		ambience = "event:/SFX/Events/Backgrounds/temple_christian"
	}

	window_characters = {
		host = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location = scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					scope:host = {
						add_to_list = characters
					}
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = personality_bold
			}
		}
		travel_host = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location != scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					scope:host = {
						add_to_list = characters
					}
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = jockey_walk
			}
		}
		guest = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				every_attending_character = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location = scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					add_to_list = characters
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = happiness
			}
		}
	}
}

				ai_will_do = {

				}
			}
		}
	}

	phases = {

			is_predefined = yes

				if = {
					limit = { this = scope:host }

					trigger_event = { id = eir.1109 days = 2 }

			on_end = {

											option = eir_hosting_scale_grand

									}
								}

									add_dread = medium_dread_gain
								}
							}
							every_attending_character = {

### Bardic Contest

	is_shown = {
		eir_act_bardic_host_trigger = yes
	}

					limit = { this = scope:host }
					trigger_event = { id = eir.1112 days = 3 }

						add_activity_log_entry = {
							key = eir_bardic_conc
							score = 100
							show_in_conclusion = yes
							character = root
							if = {
								limit = {
									scope:activity = {
										has_activity_option = {
											category = eir_bardic_scale
											option = eir_bardic_scale_modest
										}
									}
								}
								root = {
									add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
								}
							}
							else_if = {
								limit = {
									scope:activity = {
										has_activity_option = {
											category = eir_bardic_scale
											option = eir_bardic_scale_fair
										}
									}
								}
								root = {
									add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
								}
							}
							else_if = {
								limit = {
									scope:activity = {
										has_activity_option = {
											category = eir_bardic_scale
											option = eir_bardic_scale_grand
										}
									}
								}
								root = {
									add_prestige = major_prestige_gain
								}
							}
							every_attending_character = {
								limit = { this != root }
								custom = every_guest_scope_tt
								add_opinion = {
									target = root
									modifier = eir_act_hosted_opinion
									opinion = 10
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	pulse_actions = {
		entries = { eir_bardic_praise eir_bardic_epic eir_bardic_lesson eir_bardic_patron eir_bardic_laugh eir_bardic_satire eir_bardic_fail eir_bardic_feud eir_bardic_harp }
		chance_of_no_event = 15
	}

	max_guests = 25

	guest_invite_rules = {
		defaults = {
			1 = activity_invite_rule_friends
			2 = activity_invite_rule_vassals
			3 = activity_invite_rule_courtiers
		}
		rules = {
			2 = activity_invite_rule_close_family
			3 = activity_invite_rule_fellow_vassals
			4 = activity_invite_rule_rivals_if_appropriate
		}
	}

	can_be_activity_guest = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_available = yes
		in_diplomatic_range = scope:host
	}

	host_intents = {
		intents = { eir_recite_intent eir_patron_intent eir_learn_intent reduce_stress_intent }
		default = reduce_stress_intent
	}

	guest_intents = {
		intents = { eir_recite_intent eir_patron_intent eir_learn_intent reduce_stress_intent }
		default = reduce_stress_intent
	}

	guest_join_chance = {
		base = 20
		base_activity_modifier = yes
		activity_guest_shared_ai_accept_modifier = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
	}

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 0
		empire = 0
		hegemony = 0
	}

	ai_will_select_province = {
		value = 10
	}

	map_entity = "building_western_feast_01_entity"

	header_background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/activity_header_backgrounds/activity_feast.dds"

	background = {
		trigger = {
			scope:host.location != scope:activity.activity_location
		}
		texture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/ep2_travel_hills.dds"
		environment = "environment_travel_hills_settlement"
		ambience = "event:/SFX/Events/Backgrounds/fields_farms_day"
	}
	background = {

		environment = "environment_event_feast"
		ambience = "event:/SFX/Events/Backgrounds/feasthall"
	}

	window_characters = {
		host = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location = scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					scope:host = {
						add_to_list = characters
					}
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = personality_bold
			}
		}
		travel_host = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location != scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					scope:host = {
						add_to_list = characters
					}
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = jockey_walk
			}
		}
		guest = {
			camera = camera_event_center
			effect = {
				every_attending_character = {
					limit = {
						scope:host.location = scope:activity.activity_location
					}
					add_to_list = characters
				}
			}
			scripted_animation = {
				animation = happiness
			}
		}
	}
